question: Among male patients diagnosed with high cholesterol (T-CHO ≥ 250), find those whose creatinine level is out of the normal range (≥ 1.5) and who were under 60 years old at the time of their laboratory test in 1984. For this group, calculate what percentage had uric acid (UA) levels above the male normal threshold (> 8.0).

prediction.sql:
SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN L."XCL_022" > 8.0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(*) AS percentage
FROM Patient AS P
INNER JOIN Laboratory AS L ON P."XCL_058" = L."XCL_014"
WHERE P."XCL_059" = 'M'
  AND L."XCL_026" >= 250
  AND L."XCL_056" >= 1.5
  AND L."XCL_016" < 60
  AND strftime('%Y', L."XCL_015") = '1984'
